content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by noting that the sign verse itself does not state the mechanism, i.e., by a verse-level silence/stating-verse test rather than chain-against-chain footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"Phrase: 'never verse by verse' — read one way, it forbids making a link underdetermined because the single sign verse's own words do not state the mechanism; read the other way, it would allow noting that silence as just one part of a chain-against-chain assessment.","why":"The judge made the verse's own silence about the mechanism decisive enough to call the link underdetermined, which is the verse-by-verse stating-verse test K-C retires."}
